'''Paul van Hoorne''' (also published as '''Paul van Horne''') is a Dutch Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 Helmond tournament]] on 16 April 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time]], according to Jeroen van den Bosch's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d549">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-netherlands-helmond-16-04-2000d549/ netherlands-helmond-16-04-2000], DeckTech (Jeroen "S.T.oma" van den Bosch, 18 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-netherlands-helmond-16-04-2000d549/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He played This Deal again at the [[2000 Dutch National Championship]] on 21 May 2000, according to Johan Haneveer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d796">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-dutch-championship-21-05-00d796/ dutch-championship-21-05-00], DeckTech (Johan "Joh" Haneveer, 22 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-22-dutch-championship-21-05-00d796/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
